card.name: Words just before the number one
card.fires_on: Small words or spaces right before a count of one, such as 'only', 'at least', 'more than', 'at a time' or 'on' one side. The next word is usually 1 or one.

modes.label: Space before 1
modes.description: A blank gap after 'only', 'at least' or 'and' just before a digit 1.

modes.label: Linking word before one
modes.description: A word like 'than', 'at' or 'on' that leads into 'one' or 'a time'.

card.plain: It fires on the small word or gap just before the text says one of something.
